mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.resource_id, r.user_id, r.score, r.content, r.status, r.like_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM cms_resource_review r WHERE r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.id, r.resource_id, r.user_id, u.nickname, r.score, r.content, r.status, r.like_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, 0 AS liked_by_me, 1 AS mine FROM cms_resource_review r INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score), 1), 0.0) AS average_score, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM cms_resource_review WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.resource_id, a.title AS resource_title, a.status AS resource_status, CASE WHEN a.deleted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resource_deleted, r.score, r.content, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM cms_resource_review r INNER JOIN cms_article a ON a.id = r.resource_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_resource_review SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
